Derive an analysis-ready data set listing viral loads (VL)

Source: R/get_VLs.R
get_VLs.Rd

Derive an analysis-ready data set listing viral loads (VL)

Usage

get_VLs(missing_result = 199, cache = "use")

Arguments

missing_result

Numeric value (including NA_integer_) to impute for the result when (1) the person's VL records for that date are all missing a value for result and (2) some have an interpretation of '<' or 'ND' and none have an interpretation of '>'.

cache

Whether to use or overwrite cached results. Must be one of 'use' (the default), 'overwrite', or 'ignore'. If cache = 'use' (the default) and a dataset was generated by a previous call to this function using the same parameters and the same eHARS data and was cached, the cached dataset is returned, otherwise a dataset is derived and cached. If cache = 'overwrite', a dataset is (re-)derived and (re-)cached, overwriting any existing analogous dataset in the cache. If cache = 'ignore', a dataset is re-derived but not (re-)cached.

Value

A data.frame unique by stateno + sample_dt_char (i.e., the original value in lab.sample_dt). Contains variables sample_dt (Date; .. imputed as 15 and .... imputed as 0630), max_result_unimputed (num), result (num; equals missing_result under the conditions specified above, otherwise equals max_result_unimputed), result_interpretation (chr; 'I' and '=' are omitted), first_enter_dt (Date; earliest enter_dt for any document with a VL with this stateno + sample_dt), document_uid, and facility (chr).

Details

The cached dataset is stored in the "/Derived" subdirectory of the date-specific folder containing the eHARS datasets. If no such directory exists when this function is called, it creates it.

Examples

vls <- get_VLs()
#> Error: '//kc/dph/prevention/hiv/Epi/EXTRA SPACE/eHARS/Full eHARS/Archive/NA/document_sas7bdat/lab.sas7bdat' does not exist.
